game_updates.contents: We are pleased to present the updated Roadmap for Wild Terra 2: New Lands Please note that the order of items is random, and updates may be released in a different order. Please remember to support Wild Terra 2 with reviews, as they are very important for Steam algorithms. Thank you! Purchase Wild Terra 2 and additional packs: https://www.wildterra2.com/Wild Terra 2 on Steam:

game_updates.title: Hotfix 1.6.0.475 is live!
game_updates.contents: Lord Captains! Yet another hotfix 1.6.0.475 is on the way, fixing two major bugs: Inability to jump into the vent during the Void Shadows storyline - fixed; It was possible to gain access to Act V systems via Trazyn's Museion, completely breaking the game - fixed; We are delivering this hotfix quickly to stop the Act V problem from appearing again, but reverting the progress on existing saves requires more research and will come in other upcoming updates. If you had this issue in your playthrough, for now please load an earlier save. We are sorry for the inconvenience. As usual, consoles will get the update with up to 48 hours delay.

game_updates.contents: The Witcher 3's multiplayer mod, the world's premier tool for forming big towers of multiple Geralts precariously perched atop each others' shoulders, has added another string to its bow. You can now meet up with some mates at a tavern to play games of Gwent against them, a concept so appealing CD Projekt made a whole game out of it. Read more

game_updates.title: Hotfix 3.0.430
game_updates.contents: - Temporarily reduced the dominium lifetime on the starting island to 4 hours (if you do not enter the game for 4 hours, the dominium will automatically be packed into your inventory).- Fixed an issue where storage icons were displayed for hidden buildings (for example, on another floor). - Plague rats now have the Plague monsters type instead of Animals.- Likely fixed issues that could cause combat skill level icons in the bottom-right corner not to display.- Oath lifesteal now works more correctly with abilities that finish off the target.- Slightly reduced mob damage in the 65-75 and 75-85 Shattered Castle. - Unique decor rewards from Shattered Castle can now be disassembled.- Likely fixed an issue where, in rare cases, a premium scroll could disappear from Legacy.

game_updates.contents: Lord Captains! game_updates.title: New Deadlock update aims to stop snowballing - and it's looking like Holliday season
game_updates.contents: Valve's latest Deadlock update is here, and this week is mostly about hero balance changes, although there are some notable tweaks that should push back against the recent trend for matches to snowball. I've sifted through the patch notes to figure out the big winners and losers, and I'd expect Holliday, Apollo, and Calico players to have big smiles on their faces. If you're more into Graves, Silver, or Seven, however, you might want to look away. Let's dig into all the important stuff you need to know before diving into the MOBA this weekend. Read the full story on PCGamesN: New Deadlock update aims to stop snowballing - and it's looking like Holliday season
